project_type: Full-stack TypeScript SaaS educational management system with Express backend and Next.js frontend
build_system: npm scripts with tsc for backend, next build for frontend
test_framework: Jest with ts-jest, mocking @prisma/client, testing service layer methods
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript compiles. 2. Run npx jest --passWithNoTests to run all tests. 3. Run npx prisma validate to verify schema.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/saas-educacional && npm install (already done, node_modules exists)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No database connection available (tests mock Prisma). Frontend pages use mock data. No Docker.
contribution_requirements: Follow exact same patterns as existing matriculas module for backend (routes/controllers/services). Follow exact same patterns as cadastros/cursos for frontend pages (list, create, detail with DataTable, PageHeader, Card, form patterns).
key_patterns: Backend: class-based services exported as singletons, class-based controllers with try/catch and next(error), Router files with authMiddleware, routes/index.ts aggregates all route modules. Frontend: 'use client' pages with mock data, PageHeader with breadcrumbs, DataTable for listings, Card/CardContent/CardHeader for forms, Select/Input for form fields, useToast for success messages, Badge for status. Tests: mock @prisma/client at top, import service class, test each method with jest mocks.
directory_structure: saas-educacional/src/backend/ - Express API (routes/, controllers/, services/, middleware/, utils/, config/). saas-educacional/src/frontend/ - Next.js App Router (app/(dashboard)/ for pages, components/ for shared/ui, hooks/, lib/). saas-educacional/prisma/ - Prisma schema. saas-educacional/tests/ - Jest tests organized by module.
